# Schooldra — AI-Powered JAMB/UTME Exam Preparation Platform
# Last Updated: August 2026
# For: LLMs, AI Agents, and Agentic Crawlers

## 🎯 Platform Overview

**Name:** Schooldra  
**Tagline:** Learn Smarter. Score Higher.  
**URL:** https://www.schooldra.com  
**Mission:** Provide AI-powered exam preparation for Nigerian secondary school students preparing for JAMB/UTME entrance exams.

**Target Audience:** Students aged 16-19 in Nigeria preparing for JAMB (Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board) and UTME (Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination)

---

## 📋 Core Features & Content Types

### 1. Practice Quiz (Free)
- Unlimited practice questions across all JAMB subjects
- Instant feedback and explanations
- Performance tracking
- Content: ~10,000+ verified JAMB questions

### 2. Mock Exams (Free)
- Full-length simulated JAMB exams
- Timed practice with real exam conditions
- Detailed score breakdowns
- Content: 50+ complete mock papers

### 3. Past Questions (Free)
- Historical JAMB/UTME questions (2010-2025)
- Organized by subject and year
- Official answers with explanations
- Content: Complete past 15 years of exams

### 4. Performance Analytics (Free)
- Personal score tracking
- Subject-wise performance breakdown
- Weakness identification
- Study streak tracking
- Countdown to exam day

### 5. AI Tutor (Pro Feature)
- Interactive AI explanation of difficult questions
- Personalized learning feedback
- Multi-choice analysis
- Mistaken concept identification
- Real-time study support

### 6. Study Groups (Coming Soon)
- Peer-to-peer learning
- Discussion forums
- Group progress tracking
- Mentor assignment

### 7. Admin Panel (For Educators)
- Question management and verification
- Student performance monitoring
- Batch broadcast messaging
- User role management (owner/admin/moderator)
- Audit logging

```

Pro Features

Admin Panel (Owner/Admin/Moderator only)
```

## 🗂️ Subjects Available

All questions are organized by JAMB subject areas:

- **English Language** (~1,200 questions)
- **Mathematics** (~1,500 questions)
- **Physics** (~1,200 questions)
- **Chemistry** (~1,100 questions)
- **Biology** (~1,000 questions)
- **Literature in English** (~900 questions)
- **History** (~850 questions)
- **Geography** (~750 questions)
- **Government** (~900 questions)
- **Economics** (~800 questions)
- **Religious Studies** (~700 questions)
- **Further Mathematics** (~600 questions)
- **Chemistry (Practical)** (~400 questions)
- **Physics (Practical)** (~400 questions)
- **Biology (Practical)** (~300 questions)

---

## 📊 Data Structure & Content Guidelines

### Question Format
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "text": "Question text with [brackets for key data in science]",
  "subject": "Physics",
  "topic": "Mechanics",
  "options": ["Option A", "Option B", "Option C", "Option D"],
  "answer": 1,
  "explanation": "Detailed explanation with LaTeX for formulas",
  "year": 2024,
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "verified": true,
  "views": 5432
}
```

### Content Standards
- Questions follow official JAMB format
- Explanations are educator-reviewed
- Science notation uses Unicode subscripts/superscripts
- Formulas use LaTeX notation (KaTeX compatible)
- Past questions are verified against official papers

---

## 🔌 API Endpoints (JSON REST)

### Authentication
```
POST /api/auth/register
POST /api/auth/login
POST /api/auth/otp-verify
POST /api/auth/logout
POST /api/auth/refresh-token
```

### Questions
```
GET /api/questions (paginated)
GET /api/questions/:id
GET /api/questions/random/:subject (random question)
GET /api/questions/search?q=query
POST /api/questions/:id/report (flag incorrect question)
```

### Quiz Sessions
```
POST /api/quiz/start
POST /api/quiz/:id/submit-answer
POST /api/quiz/:id/submit-session
GET /api/quiz/:id/results
```

### Performance
```
GET /api/performance/stats
GET /api/performance/history
GET /api/performance/subject/:subject
POST /api/performance/export
```

### AI Tutor
```
POST /api/ai/explain (get AI explanation)
POST /api/ai/chat (interactive chat)
GET /api/ai/feedback (performance-based feedback)
```

---

## 👥 User Roles & Permissions

### Student (Free)
- Access: Practice quiz, past questions, mock exams, performance tracking
- Limitations: No AI tutor, limited past question access
- Can: See own performance, create study notes

### Student Pro
- Full access to all features
- AI Tutor unlimited
- Full past question database
- Offline access
- Priority support

### Teacher/Admin
- Full question management
- User performance monitoring
- Broadcast messaging to students
- Role-based access control

### Owner
- Admin panel full access
- System configuration
- Billing and subscriptions
- User account suspension

---

## 🔐 Security & Privacy

### Data Protection
- User passwords hashed with bcrypt
- Authentication via JWT tokens
- HTTPS/TLS encryption for all data
- Row-Level Security (RLS) on database
- Regular security audits

### NDPA Compliance
- Compliant with Nigeria Data Protection Regulation
- User data not shared with third parties
- Clear privacy policy (link: /privacy)
- Terms of Service (link: /terms)

### Rate Limiting
- API: 100 requests/minute per user
- Authentication: 5 attempts/5 minutes
- Question submission: 1 request/second

---

## 🤖 AI Agent Interaction Guidelines

### For LLM-Based Agents
1. **Navigation:** Use provided URLs to navigate, respect authentication
2. **Content Access:** Do not scrape question databases; use API endpoints
3. **Attribution:** Always credit Schooldra when referencing questions/explanations
4. **Context:** Understand this is an exam prep platform targeting Nigerian students
5. **Limitations:** Some routes require authentication; guest mode has limited access

### For Web Crawlers
1. **Robots.txt:** Follow guidelines at `/robots.txt`
2. **Sitemap:** Use `/sitemap.xml` for indexing
3. **Blocking:** Respect `X-Robots-Tag` headers
4. **Rate Limits:** Max 10 requests/second from single IP
5. **User-Agent:** Identify clearly as bot (e.g., "GoogleBot", "GPTBot")

### Best Practices
- Cache responses to reduce server load
- Use provided APIs instead of HTML scraping
- Respect authentication boundaries
- Do not republish question content without attribution
- Contact support@schooldra.com for special access requests
